FINAL_for_paper.method: UMA-s-1p1 (omat) Langevin NVT MD; D from Li MSD = 6 D t, fit window 2-50 ps (msd_origin default); 3-pt Arrhenius (600/800/1000 K); Nernst-Einstein sigma = n q^2 D / (kB T), Haven = 1. SAME pipeline reproduces the validated deck slide for modelc exactly.
FINAL_for_paper.vs_modelc: Ea identical (modelc 0.2235); sigma 1.33x higher, D0-driven (1.24x). See b2o3_vs_modelc_md.json.

supplementary_lowT_400_500.note: low-T MD for curvature check. D extracted at the MD script's own window (5-40 ps); NOT yet re-extracted at 2-50 ps, so do NOT mix into the FINAL 3-pt fit above. 400 K D has the largest statistical noise (slow diffusion, marginal MSD diffusive regime).
supplementary_lowT_400_500.curvature_verdict: segment Ea zig-zags (no clean super-Arrhenius). To fold into a consistent 5-pt fit, re-extract the 400/500 K MSD arrays (gabia) at 2-50 ps.

caveat: MLIP classical Nernst-Einstein (Haven=1) overestimates ABSOLUTE sigma ~3-5x for the LPSCl family. Robust quantities = Ea and the relative b2o3-vs-modelc ratio (same method/window). Absolute sigma is an upper bound.

SUPERSEDED.note: earlier (5-40 ps) fits, retained for traceability only; the (5-40) window faked a b2o3 Ea advantage via modelc's window-sensitive 800 K point.
